newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling weakens on dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling weakens on dollar, pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling weakened against the dollar and pound on Friday in line with market expectations of a slow depreciation after the June 19 budget, dealers said.
The shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 624.2445 against the dollar from 624.1950 on Thursday. Last Friday the shilling exchanged at 623.7000 against the dollar.
Against the pound the shilling exchanged at mean rate 1040.7436 compared to 1039.0678 on Thursday.
The depreciation to a trading band of between 650-700 is based on market expectations of higher imports due to reduced taxes and levies.
"Market sentiment is for this downward creep to continue for a while. There's a lot of people with dollars to sell who are waiting," said one financial analyst.
